# Charlotta

[Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge)

## Overview

- **Age:** 14  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057)</sub>

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Charlotta has a freckled face featuring a snubbed nose and a notably wide mouth and smile. Though she previously wore blue ribbon bows in her hair, she later discarded them in favor of styling her hair in an enormous pompadour.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P58](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0058), [v3 ch.People P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007)_

## Personality

Charlotta is a warm-hearted and dedicated handmaiden who holds an earnest concern for her mistress's well-being. She demonstrates deep devotion and a highly obedient nature, willing to follow any instruction given to her by her mistress.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P73](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0073), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)_

## History

Charlotta the Fourth came to live at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) as a fourteen-year-old servant to Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). She befriended [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during Anne's visits to the cottage and shared her worries about Miss Lavendar's listlessness, which led to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helping reunite Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) with her old love, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). Charlotta assisted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) with the preparations for Miss Lavendar's garden wedding and later helped [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) clean the house after the couple departed. In the following years, Charlotta remained a familiar presence at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), spending time with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) during their frequent visits.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P4](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0004), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P6](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0006), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P11](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0011), +275 more_

> "But I’m sure I shan’t sleep a blessed wink, Miss Shirley, ma’am, for fear that something’ll go wrong at the last minute . . . the cream won’t whip . . . or Mr. Irving’ll have a stroke and not be able to come."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P14](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0014)

## Relationships

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

Charlotta serves as a young house servant for Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where she is playfully designated as "Charlotta the Fourth." She cares deeply for her employer's well-being, openly expressing concern to visitors like [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) when Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) becomes listless or lacks spirit. Charlotta faithfully assists Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) with household tasks, such as cleaning silver and helping her prepare for Stephen Irving's visit.

- Serves under — employer who directs her house servant  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P70](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0070), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), +3 more</sub>
